drop_desc: Upload a high-resolution image of a grapevine leaf. The AI will scan for Esca, Black Rot, or Leaf Blight.
chat_welcome: Hello! I'm VineGuard AI. Do you have any questions about vineyard care?
error_mic_access: Error: Could not access microphone. Please check browser permissions.
disease_desc_Black_rot: Fungal infection (Guignardia bidwellii) causing severe tissue necrosis.
disease_rec1_Black_rot: Remove infected leaves and shoots immediately.
disease_rec3_Black_rot: Improve air circulation within the canopy.
disease_desc_Esca: Wood fungal complex that obstructs vascular flow.
disease_rec1_Esca: Mark the vine and isolate tools after pruning.
disease_rec2_Esca: Cut the trunk below the necrotic tissue.
disease_rec3_Esca: Seal major cuts with fungicidal mastic.
disease_desc_Leaf_blight: Foliar disease causing premature drying and vigor loss.
disease_rec1_Leaf_blight: Reduce water stress and avoid sprinkler irrigation.
disease_rec2_Leaf_blight: Remove fallen plant debris in autumn.
disease_desc_Healthy: Healthy foliar tissue with no detectable presence of known pathogens.
disease_rec1_Healthy: Maintain current nutritional and irrigation program.
disease_rec3_Healthy: Optimize soil drainage in the plot.
